name: Hi, Rockits! public quality, system, and business audit

coordinate_model.O: official public URL + unauthenticated state + observation time
coordinate_model.Z: raw public response first; rendered desktop/mobile confirmation second
coordinate_model.T: navigation -> settled response -> normalization -> human judgment

markers: 72% офферов / предложений о работе принимают кандидаты

assertions.marker: Хотела написать, что я за 3 дня успешно оформилась в компании

markers: Person behind CV is more important, than the text in it.

findings.title: Buyer-facing performance metrics are inconsistent on the same page
findings.quality_lens: The landing page publishes different values for the same client-count and offer-acceptance concepts.
findings.system_lens: Marketing KPIs appear duplicated across page blocks without a shared source or freshness rule.
findings.business_lens: Conflicting proof metrics can weaken trust during agency comparison and procurement review.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm both value pairs in settled desktop and mobile renders; human review must confirm the intended metric definitions.

findings.title: Salary analytics prices use a potentially mis-scaled monetary unit
findings.quality_lens: Several prices are displayed with the suffix т.р., which conventionally denotes thousands of rubles and may multiply the intended amounts by 1,000.
findings.system_lens: Price amount and currency/unit formatting are not protected by a typed display contract.
findings.business_lens: Ambiguous pricing can interrupt purchase intent and create avoidable clarification work for sales.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm the exact labels in desktop and mobile; do not claim the intended commercial amount without company context.

findings.title: The candidate journey contains duplicated social proof and visible copy defects
findings.quality_lens: Candidate testimonials repeat and nearby candidate-facing text contains spacing and spelling defects.
findings.system_lens: Carousel/content blocks and specialization taxonomy lack deduplication and editorial acceptance checks.
findings.business_lens: Defects on the resume-submission journey can reduce confidence among senior candidates.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm duplication and exact wording in settled desktop and mobile renders.

findings.title: The English acquisition surface contains mixed-language and editorial defects
findings.quality_lens: The English page contains grammatical defects, concatenated words, a wrong word, and a Russian phrase.
findings.system_lens: Localization content lacks a language-consistency and proofreading gate.
findings.business_lens: International buyers may infer lower delivery maturity from the English storefront.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm every marker is visible in desktop and mobile, not only present in source markup.
